Storm Breakers - patches applied for Unity 6000.6 / URP 17.6 (keep this file up to date)

2026-09-08 - Import into Unity 6000.6.0f1 (from upstream commit 2024-04-10, Unity 2021.3 / URP 12 origin).
  - Added StormBreakers.Runtime.asmdef (references Unity.Burst, Unity.Collections, Unity.Mathematics). No source change.
  - Shader Graphs (8) and VFX Graphs (3) upgraded automatically at import: no errors reported by ShaderUtil.ShaderHasError.
  - Smoke test: scene 1-Examples/Epic Surfing/surfing.unity plays. KNOWN ISSUE: the example scripts (CameraController.cs,
    Examples scripts/InputRotation.cs, GameControl.cs) use the legacy UnityEngine.Input API while the project uses
    'Input System package' only -> InvalidOperationException in Play Mode in the example scenes. These scripts are NOT used
    by Biscotte; do not switch Active Input Handling to 'Both' for them. If the examples are needed for testing, port them to
    the Input System or temporarily set Active Input Handling = Both and revert.

Planned patches (see Docs/BISCOTTE_SPEC.md P1-T2): ambientProbe-based particle lighting, ResetStatics for Fast Enter Play Mode,
wave-mask globals in ocean.shadergraph, FindObjectOfType -> FindFirstObjectByType, Camera.main injection in BreakersAudio.
